load_vocoder_config: load a vocoder configuration using the ConfigLoader with asset_store and vocoder_archs
load_vocoder_model: load a vocoder model using ModelLoader with asset_store, download_manager, config loader, and checkpoint converter
convert_vocoder_checkpoint: convert a vocoder checkpoint from old generator key format to new code_generator key format

build_vocoder_pipeline: build a vocoder inference pipeline by loading config and model from fairseq2 asset store
